title: Register a residential service
what: Conduct a residential service (such as a boarding house) only if the service, provider and premises are registered.

sources.title: Residential Services (Accreditation) Act 2002 (Qld)
sources.quote: A person must not conduct a residential service in premises unless— (a) the service is registered under this part; and (b) the person is registered as the service provider for the service; and (c) the premises are the registered premises for the service
